subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR wait for visible latest-head legacy no-code SQLite upgrade proof before merge, or is the current source, tests, and summarized proof enough for the compatibility-sensitive runtime fallback?
rationale: The patch is a plausible bug fix, but it changes persisted registry upgrade behavior and the remaining proof gap is about maintainer proof sufficiency rather than a narrow code defect.

options.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal/live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on the reviewed head.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the code inspection, regression tests, and summarized proof as enough while owning the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Migration
options.body: Pause the runtime fallback and require the legacy no-code cleanup to live in doctor or migration-owned code instead.

recommendation.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal/live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on the reviewed head.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and have recent current-main ownership evidence in the affected plugin registry path.
